about.content: Hey — I'm Amit. Growth marketer, product builder, and recovering jack-of-all-trades based in Jaipur.

I've spent the last decade at the **intersection of growth, product, and tech** — most recently co-founding **Traveleva**, where I ran strategy, product, marketing, and ops all at once (founders will get it).

The last 6 months I've gone deep on AI — building automation systems, prompt pipelines, and AI-driven workflows that compress execution time dramatically. 3,000+ prompts curated, a standalone product live at promptmasterclass.in, a fully automated Medium pipeline, and a handful of side quests shipped solo.

about.title: TL;DR
about.content: I'm adaptable, I learn fast, and I help teams ship 10× faster by knowing exactly where and how to apply AI.
